title: akika
summary: bixel's partner, killed by the russian state before the fracture. the origin of the deep-grief vocabulary of kahu-tok.

title: bixel
summary: post-collapse linguist who designed kahu-tok, the constructed trade language that became the kahu mother tongue.

title: edi
summary: head of the zou-esh in the mid-bloom who ended the kahu's first government by administrative capture, and was deposed and exiled.

title: hanna miskinnis
summary: pre-impact researcher whose work became the basis for the longs' immortality and the kahu purist tradition. died in the fracture. her name survives in the present in one place only, the purist tradition, which keeps it as a founding vow; outside that lineage she is the unnamed refusal of the deep records.

title: mara
summary: the most famous and most prolific zou-esh on record. died defending the gate. the figure history coalesced around.

title: the bunker survivors
summary: the surviving populations of the deep mountain bunkers in the idaho rockies and the blue mountains of eastern oregon who rode out the dark century underground and became the founding generation of the kahu.

title: the cat-farmers
summary: the small farming group living below the caldera who had preserved the ancestors of the kahu cats. brought into tora vyl drak by mara's diplomatic mission. absorbed into the kahu through the standard integration process.

title: the longs
kahu_tok: not a kahu-tok term; the kahu have no word for them
summary: the immortal elite who took hanna miskinnis's longevity intervention for themselves and sealed it inside arcologies. sealed in further by the leveling. forgotten by the surface. the kahu know the pre-fracture history but do not know the longs survive to the present.

title: the yamantau descendants
summary: the multi-generational migration from the yamantau bunker in russia to the cascade arc. the descendants who arrived became kahu. the journey took generations.

title: yelena cruz
summary: bixel's student, who completed and formalized kahu-tok after bixel's death. not remembered in the kahu's later account of the language.

title: hart-ston
summary: the active volcanic cone within the caldera. heart-stone. sacred. the source of the residual heat that keeps the kahu alive.

title: hart-wata
summary: the great lake at the center of the caldera. heart-water. the kahu's primary freshwater source and the geographic center of life inside tora vyl drak.

title: hot-kasa
summary: the principal kahu settlement. roughly 120,000 people live in chambers tunneled through lava tubes in the hearth, heated by the geothermal grid.

title: komi-wata
summary: the river of the south quadrant. it feeds the vyl-tapi algae terraces and the croplands of sun-tera, the breadbasket of the caldera.

title: mara-skol
summary: the zou-esh training institution. mara-school. located at the gate, the place where mara died. the school is the order's living continuity with her.

title: nu-tera
summary: the agricultural plateau wrapping the southern caldera. home, quarantine point, and farmland for roughly 30,000 kahu. the new-land.

title: ol-tri shen
summary: the old-tree forest preserve in the wilds. the kahu's longest-running deliberate non-cultivation. the closest thing inside the caldera to ancient ecology.

title: sun-tera
summary: the south quadrant of the caldera. the breadbasket. sun-land. the kahu's primary agricultural zone inside the caldera proper.

title: the gate
summary: the chokepoint where the long climb meets the nu-tera plateau. the place where mara died. the home and training ground of the modern zou-esh.

title: the great western sea
summary: the toxic inland sea created by the 2075 cascadia impact when the pacific flooded the willamette valley. the western horizon of the kahu's world.

title: the hearth
summary: the west quadrant of the caldera. holds the geothermal grid, the principal settlement of hot-kasa, and most of the kahu's industrial and infrastructure systems.

title: the long climb
summary: the narrow ascent path from the lowlands to the nu-tera plateau. the only land approach to the kahu sanctuary. impassable in winter.

title: the stone climb
summary: the 800ft spiral walkway cut into the rock face that connects the nu-tera plateau to the caldera floor. the second of the two ascents into tora vyl drak.

title: the threshold
summary: the eastern quadrant of the caldera floor, the transitional country where the stone climb tops the inner face. the caldera's front door.

title: the wilds
summary: the north quadrant of the caldera. mostly unsettled. holds the ol-tri shen forest preserve and the kahu's principal contact with non-cultivated ecology inside the rim.

title: the wrap-around
summary: the northern wrap-around of the nu-tera plateau. the cat-kahu's territory. home to the kahu cats, the breeding programs, and the livestock operations that feed them.

title: tora vyl drak
summary: the eighteen-mile volcanic caldera that has been the kahu sanctuary since the first descent, around 2120 ad.

title: ven-kasa
summary: the come-house. the arrival hall and quarantine houses nearest the gate on nu-tera, where newcomers live their first seasons.

title: the caldera shudder
summary: a violent subterranean seismic warning beneath the caldera. shook the kahu sense of permanent sanctuary and accelerated the schism.

title: the first descent
summary: the staggered arrival of the surviving groups onto the cooled floor of the caldera and the seating of the first council. the founding of the kahu civilization.

title: the fracture
summary: the comet strike that ended the pre-collapse world. two fragments, two continents, a global emp, and the beginning of the dark century.

title: the great eruption
summary: the vei-8 super-eruption of the cascade volcanic arc that formed the kahu vyl caldera. delayed consequence of the 2075 cascadia impact. the geological event that made tora vyl drak possible.

title: the great silence
summary: the global electromagnetic pulse that ended the age of electricity in the moments of the fracture. the moment the pre-collapse world went dark.

title: the leveling
summary: the coordinated emp counter-strike by surface survivors against the longs' arcologies. the act that sealed the longs in permanently.

title: the schism
summary: the unfolding kahu disagreement over biological intervention and the proper duration of life. the central live conflict of the present moment.

title: the seizure
summary: the mid-bloom episode in which the head of the zou-esh captured the sanctuary and ended the kahu's first government, and the resistance that deposed and exiled him.

title: age of bloom
summary: the twelve-hundred-year golden age of kahu civilization. the era during which warden was realized, biotech matured, and the kahu way of life reached its utopian apex.

title: age of endura
summary: the modern era of the kahu. the long time of troubles, the schism, and the questions the golden age did not have to answer.

title: age of tapestry
summary: the founding era of the kahu civilization. the great coalescence. the centuries of language-building, institution-building, and the messenger missions that drew distant survivors to tora vyl drak.

title: the dark century
summary: the roughly forty-five years between the fracture and the first descent. the hyper-winter, the bunker survival, the bastard tongue, and the long watch. the era before the kahu.

title: fas-big
summary: the zou-esh's unsanctioned rite of challenge. undertaking it carries an automatic two hits against the member, one short of the limit of three.

title: importance-first syntax
summary: the foundational syntactic principle of kahu-tok. the most important element of a sentence leads. emphasis is visible from the first word.

title: kahu
summary: the kahu people and the kahu principle. one word at every scale of community. the unit of human life. the central commitment of the world.

title: kau-esh
summary: the little kahu. those in zou-esh training who have not yet completed it, and those who began the training and washed out. not a slight. a recognized place in kahu life.

title: peli-shen
summary: the radiotrophic fungus that has rendered the lowlands lethal. the creeping dark. the reason the kahu live above five thousand feet.

title: the bastard tongue
summary: the simplified english-creole patois spoken by the bunker survivors of the dark century. predecessor language to kahu-tok. place-talk.

title: the bixel 1000
summary: the engineered core of the kahu-tok language: roughly three hundred fifty working roots, ninety of them kept from the old languages, with compounds and set phrases carrying the count to the thousand. bixel's deliberate design.

title: the cascade
summary: the volcanic arc that holds tora vyl drak. the bones of the range. the geographic condition of kahu existence.

title: the creeping dark
summary: the kahu name for the slow neurotoxic descent caused by accumulating peli-shen exposure. the experience of the lowlands.

title: the deliberate absences
summary: the words kahu-tok was built without. no money, no debt, no rent, no interest, no word for own. the lexicon's argument against the sovereign individual, made by what it refuses to say.

title: the dual mandate
kahu_tok: the vyl and the no (open canon)
summary: the two formal halves of the zou-esh mission. the search, the sacred duty of finding survivors and scavenging vital resources, and the study, the scientific work of ecological and archaeological data-gathering.

title: the five filters of uniqueness
summary: the five conditions, geological and human, that together make tora vyl drak the only sanctuary of its kind on the post-fracture earth. the answer to why the kahu are not one of many.

title: the goldilocks filter
summary: the band of elevation high enough that peli-shen cannot complete its life cycle and low enough that human life remains viable. the narrow altitude window the kahu survive inside.

title: the great devaluation
summary: the decades of institutional decay, information warfare, and environmental degradation that preceded the fracture. the world that broke before the world broke.

title: the hyper-winter
summary: the years of permanent twilight and freezing temperatures that followed the fracture. the climate condition that killed nine in ten of the impact survivors.

title: the kahu cat partnership
summary: the working relationship between a zou-esh and their cat across the full arc of training, active service, and post-active life. one of the deepest institutional patterns in the kahu order.

title: the kahu cats
summary: the serval-cougar hybrid cats bred over a thousand years by the cat-kahu. partners to the zou-esh in the field. the only large companion species that came through the dark century with humanity.

title: the last walk
summary: the kahu's gravest penalty. exile beyond the rim, escorted by zou-esh, with tools, seeds, and knowledge. the kahu do not impose death. they send a person out.

title: the mountain that breathes
summary: the kahu's geothermal plume as it appeared to distant survivor pockets across the dark century. the visible signal that drew migrations to the cascade arc.

title: the naming
summary: the kahu custom of mononyms. one name per person, unique among the living, chosen a few days after birth at the warden-tender, and celebrated by the whole kahu.

title: the provisioning of tora vyl drak
summary: how the caldera and plateau feed about two hundred seventy-eight thousand people with room to spare, and why the kahu worry about food anyway.

title: the rebirth naming
summary: a purist practice surrounding the release of names at death. a freed name is passed to a child born close to the death, who is felt to carry part of the one who left.

title: the three hits
summary: the zou-esh system that tracks a member's accumulated field risk or sanction across a career. the fas-big, the unsanctioned rite of challenge, carries an automatic two hits.

title: the three waves of extinction
summary: the kahu framework for understanding how the human population collapsed across the dark century. impact, famine, poisoning.

title: the trinity lock
summary: the personalized three-stage mechanism that opens a zou-esh's jefe-tri bow into its broken-down close-quarters configuration. unique to each zou-esh. trained on for years before the weapon itself is designed.

title: the white zone
summary: the elevation above roughly 5,000 feet that is effectively free of peli-shen. below it lies the fade band, where the fungus struggles to complete its life cycle, and below that, the lowlands where it thrives.

title: warden
summary: the biological supercomputer that guides kahu agriculture, infrastructure, and decision-making. realized during the age of bloom.

title: zou-tora
summary: the hope-journey. the summer field season, when the order goes beyond the gate.

title: the cat-kahu
summary: the kahu order responsible for the breeding, training, and stewardship of the kahu cats. a small lineage-based organization on the wrap-around of the nu-tera plateau, the active biological designers of the cat species.

title: the council of six
summary: the kahu's first government. the founding council of the six main groups, later expanded to seven when the zou-esh were granted a seat. ended by the seizure around 3250.

title: the council of the tapestry
summary: the formal bicameral structure of kahu governance. an upper chamber of retired zou-esh, the council of watchers, and a lower chamber of the people's council, drawn from every major kahu and profession.

title: the council
summary: the kahu's present, second government. the bicameral council built after the seizure, which deliberates on caldera-wide questions and integrates the recommendations of the warden modeling system.

title: the kahu-silth
summary: the order of bio-artisans who grow, shape, and heal the kahu's living garments. biologist, healer, textile engineer, microbiome cultivator, and ritual artisan in one vocation.

title: the pathfinders
summary: the judicial council of the kahu. three elders, one retired zou-esh, one miskinnis purist, one master cultivator. justice is restorative and protective, and the final penalty is exile, not death.

title: the three speakers
summary: the executive triad of kahu governance. the first speaker for the people's council, the elder speaker for the watchers, and the weaver, a neutral mediator chosen jointly to articulate consensus.

title: the warden-tenders
summary: the kahu order responsible for the living systems of tora vyl drak. the apothecary-priest hybrid order that maintains the agent stack, the geothermal grid interfaces, and warden itself.

title: zou-esh
summary: the scholar-warrior order of the kahu. defenders of the gate, finders of survivors, the order that crosses thresholds.

title: air-klin
summary: the respiratory biome inoculation administered to zou-esh before deep or sustained operations below the peli-shen spore line. clean-air. cleared from the body post-mission.

title: jefe-tri
summary: the personalized bow of the zou-esh. broken-down through the trinity lock into a close-quarters weapon. designed and recrafted by each zou-esh across the years of training.

title: klin-soma
summary: the bio-monitoring undersuit worn against the skin. clean-body. tracks the zou-esh's body state continuously during operations.

title: living textiles
summary: the kahu's living garments, grown and shaped by the kahu-silth. cloth built from human hair, algae, bacteria, and viral vectors that monitors, protects, heals, and adapts to its wearer. categories include the bio-veil, the healing weave, the thermic sheath, and the braidcloth.

title: mirar-sin-ropa
summary: the passive camouflage cloak of the zou-esh. see-without-clothes. lets a stationary zou-esh disappear into terrain.

title: soma-ropa
summary: the layered suit of the zou-esh as a whole. body-clothes. encompasses the klin-soma undersuit, the ston-ropa armor cloth, and the mirar-sin-ropa camouflage cloak.

title: ston-ropa
summary: the shear-thickening cloth that forms zou-esh shirts and pants. rock-clothes. looks like ordinary clothing. hardens to rock under sudden impact.

title: ston-shen
summary: the chemosynthetic lichen-bacteria paste that sustained the bunker survivors of the dark century. rock-life. the staple that kept humanity alive during the long underground.

title: the cloth mask
summary: the filtering cloth mask of the zou-esh kit. covers nose and mouth. filters peli-shen spores at lowland concentrations. the first layer of defense against the fungus.

title: the gloves
summary: the adhering gloves of the zou-esh kit. provide controlled retention of the jefe-tri bow and its broken-down components across complex movements.

title: the zou-kit
summary: the standard field equipment of the zou-esh. mask, undersuit, armor cloth, camouflage cloak, gloves, bow. living cloth and biotech in a single working outfit.

title: drak
summary: last

title: hart
summary: heart

title: hot
summary: warm, heated

title: kaelith
summary: the kahu name for the bonded cat. the serval-cougar-descended companion species bred and held by the cat-kahu and partnered chiefly with the zou-esh.

title: kahu-tok
summary: the kahu language. literally kahu-talk.

title: kahu
summary: a community of people. the kahu people. one word at every scale.

title: kasa
summary: house, home, dwelling

title: kia-vyl
summary: live! (as a command or exhortation)

title: konsil
summary: the seated body that decides.

title: mara
summary: a shield. by extension, that which defends. taken from the name of mara, who died defending the gate.

title: micasu
summary: a warm greeting of welcome. by the middle age of tapestry the record shows micasu as a single word meaning welcome; by the bloom it had drifted to the full sense it carries now, what is mine is already yours.

title: no
summary: no; the answer-word and the grammatical negation.

title: ol-hart
summary: old-heart. the vital things of the world before, brought home.

title: peli-shen
summary: the radiotrophic fungus that has rendered the lowlands lethal. literally danger-life.

title: peli
summary: danger

title: sav
summary: to know. to hold a thing in the mind as understood.

title: shen
summary: life

title: silth
summary: the kahu-tok root for weaving, fiber, and the shaping of living textile. it appears in kahu-silth, the order of bio-artisans who make the kahu's living garments.

title: somohapian
summary: a person's life-record kept with warden; the woven memory of one kahu member, added to across a lifetime.

title: ston
summary: rock, stone

title: sun
summary: sun

title: tera
summary: land, ground, earth

title: tok-kahu
summary: the family of words. the archive's dictionary of kahu-tok, in which every word of the language holds its own entry.

title: tok-peles
summary: place-talk. the bastard tongue. the simplified english-creole patois of the bunker survivors during the dark century.

title: tonal tense
summary: the marking of time in kahu-tok. bixel's particles carry time in writing and formal use; in speech the worn-down particles survive as tones, a rising pitch for the future and a falling pitch for the past.

title: tora
summary: hope

title: toska
summary: deep sorrow; grief; anguished longing.

title: vyl
summary: the call, and the life-force that answers it. two senses the kahu decline to separate.

title: wan-slip-bak, ya-sem
summary: yesterday that feels like now; a memory so near it has not yet become the past.

title: wata
summary: water

title: zou-esh
summary: the scholar-warrior order of the kahu. used both for the order collectively and for an individual member.

title: zou-nu
summary: new-goer. a first-year at mara-skol.
